subtitle: Lesson 30 · GPU Resource Management in Clusters

eyebrow: Splitting one physical GPU into isolated instances
code:
$ sudo nvidia-smi mig -i 0 -cgi 9,9,9 -C
# creates 3 MIG instances, 1g.10gb profile, on GPU 0
# each is a separate, hardware-isolated nvidia.com/gpu resource
caption: MIG: real hardware isolation, A100/H100-class GPUs only

eyebrow: Many workloads taking turns on one whole GPU
code:
version: v1
sharing:
  timeSlicing:
    resources:
      - name: nvidia.com/gpu
        replicas: 4
caption: Time-slicing: any NVIDIA GPU, but no memory isolation between workloads

steps.label: MIG
steps.sub: real isolation, fixed profiles, A100/H100 only

steps.label: time-slicing
steps.sub: any GPU, shared memory, no isolation

subtitle: Why sharing mechanisms like these exist in the first place: idle GPUs are expensive.
